summary_en: Full-year dividend for fiscal year ending March 2027 increased from 5 yen to 10 yen per share, reflecting upward revision of full-year earnings forecast.
title_en: Notice Regarding Revision of Dividend Forecast for Fiscal Year Ending March 2027 (Dividend Increase)
translation_en_brief: Tensho Electric Industries announced on November 13, 2026, that it has revised upward its dividend forecast for the fiscal year ending March 31, 2027. The annual dividend per share has been increased from 5 yen to 10 yen, with the full dividend payable at the fiscal year-end, and no interim dividend. The revision follows an upward revision of the company's full-year consolidated earnings forecast announced on the same date. The company positions shareholder returns as a key management priority while maintaining a stable dividend policy that balances strengthened financial position with necessary internal reserves for business expansion and capital investment.
